title: AI hyperscalers are transforming debt
summary: AI hyperscalers' enormous capital needs are forcing both companies and countries to rethink how they raise financing. The shift is reshaping debt markets as funding for AI infrastructure scales up.

title: Rich turn to borrowing against private equity holdings as payouts slow
summary: Wealthy individuals are increasingly borrowing against their private equity holdings as fund payouts slow, following pension funds and institutional investors into NAV lending. The trend reflects growing demand for liquidity solutions amid a sluggish PE exit environment.

title: Aeroméxico ‘hace las maletas’ y abandona aeropuerto de Tulum por baja demanda
summary: Aeroméxico suspenderá desde el 30 de septiembre todos sus vuelos hacia y desde el aeropuerto de Tulum por baja demanda, apenas dos años después de su inauguración. La aerolínea atribuyó la decisión a condiciones de mercado, tras el fin de los subsidios que impulsaron las rutas iniciales a ese destino turístico.

title: AI Breaches Add to Safety Fears as Trump Meets Anthropic Chief
summary: Fresh disclosures about a wider range of breaches by advanced AI models have intensified global anxiety over AI risk. The news sets the stage for a high-stakes meeting between Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and President Trump on AI safety oversight.

title: AI Safety Concerns Put Congress on the Spot
summary: Rep. Don Beyer, co-chair of the Congressional AI Caucus, says recent AI incidents have increased urgency for federal safeguards, including mandatory safety testing and incident reporting for advanced models. He argues Congress should build a regulatory structure combining federal oversight with technical input from AI companies.

title: Bill Gates Says Trump Is Wrong to Hold Out Against AI Safeguards
summary: Bill Gates said government safeguards against catastrophic AI risks would not hamper US competitiveness against China, pushing back on President Trump's largely hands-off approach to AI regulation. The comments add a prominent tech voice to the growing debate over federal AI oversight.

title: Australia Senate Requests OpenAI, Anthropic CEOs Face AI Inquiry
summary: An Australian Senate inquiry has called on the CEOs of OpenAI and Anthropic to testify following the recent hack of a government website. The request adds to growing international scrutiny of AI safety and accountability.

title: China Media Says US Shares Responsibility for Managing AI
summary: Chinese state media outlet Yuyuantantian, affiliated with China Central Television, said the US and China share the ability and responsibility to manage and develop AI. The statement signals Beijing's public positioning on global AI governance.

title: EU y China abrirán un "canal de comunicación" sobre la inteligencia artificial
summary: La Unión Europea y China acordaron abrir un canal de comunicación específico sobre inteligencia artificial. La medida busca facilitar el diálogo bilateral en torno a la gobernanza y regulación de la IA.

title: México envejeció en cinco años y la presión por pagar pensiones apenas comienza
summary: México registró un envejecimiento poblacional acelerado —cinco años en el periodo analizado—, lo que intensifica la presión fiscal para el pago de pensiones. La nota advierte que este reto apenas comienza, con implicaciones de largo plazo para las finanzas públicas del país.

title: Pabellón El Eco 2020: Cronoboros / TANAT
summary: TANAT's Cronoboros pavilion draws on Mathias Goeritz's 1953 Manifesto of Emotional Architecture, reinterpreting the El Eco museum's legacy of space built to evoke sensation rather than follow classical rules. The project reasserts architecture as part of an integrated system with sculpture, painting, dance, music and poetry.

title: El dilema regulatorio de la IA en Argentina y las “tres trampas” que enfrentan empresas a la hora de invertir
summary: Argentina enfrenta el reto de actualizar su marco regulatorio de inteligencia artificial sin frenar la adopción de la tecnología. El presidente Javier Milei rechazó imponer regulaciones estrictas, argumentando que el intento de controlar el avance tecnológico solo lo retrasaría.
